verses.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise God in his sanctuary: Praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.2: Praise him for his mighty acts: Praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.3: Praise him with trumpet sound: Praise him with psaltery and harp.
verses.4: Praise him with timbrel and dance: Praise him with stringed instruments and pipe.
verses.5: Praise him with loud cymbals: Praise him with high sounding cymbals.
verses.6: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah.

metadata.source: Derived from the American Standard Version (1901), revised for the ABIDE Bible App.
